title: Services Create a Space preview wears the Services theme's own hero

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-14 ('do it') on the open follow-up from LIVE-2284: swap the Services preview to its window-washer hero.

detail: The Services builder preview hero is /sites/services/hero-squeegee.webp. Probe create-space-kit-previews was edited with the owner's go-ahead to accept it; the remaining Services pictures stay New World stand-ins.
